instruction.name: ldx.w
instruction.description: ldx.w indexed load from rj + rk.

experiments.name: high-unroll ALU-consumer chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 100000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 8; st.w $r4, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, 0; st.w $r4, $r20, 8; li.d $r4, 0; li.d $r5, 0' --asm 'ldx.w $r4, $r20, $r4; add.d $r4, $r4, $r5'
experiments.notes: L1D hit, indexed word load-to-ALU latency 5 cycles. Indexed address generation adds 1 cycle over ld.w. Measured with unroll=100000.

experiments.name: load-to-AGU bypass calibration
experiments.notes: Bare index chase with offsets 8/0. This exercises the load-to-AGU address bypass path (4 cycles); the ALU-consumer path is 5 cycles.

latencies.notes: L1D hit. Indexed word load-to-ALU latency is 5 cycles; the load-to-AGU address bypass path is 4 cycles.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56' --asm 'ldx.w $r12, $r20, $r4; ldx.w $r13, $r20, $r5; ldx.w $r14, $r20, $r6; ldx.w $r15, $r20, $r7; ldx.w $r16, $r20, $r8; ldx.w $r17, $r20, $r9; ldx.w $r18, $r20, $r10; ldx.w $r19, $r20, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent memory operations take 4.00 cycles. Buffer is at $sp-1024.

notes: L1D-hit load-to-ALU latency 5 cycles; load-to-AGU address path is 4 cycles. Throughput is 0.5 CPI.
